resources.string: Choose an older backup or a file you restored from. No recovery key is needed. TaffyGo reads only the file name and asks you to confirm before deleting it.
This name comes from the storage app. TaffyGo has not checked the contents or whether this is a valid backup. Nothing has been deleted.
Delete this selected file? This can remove your only backup. Your current profile and recovery key will not be changed.
Reading the selected file name. Nothing is being deleted…
TaffyGo could not prepare a named file for deletion. No file was deleted. Choose it again, or use the storage app.
File selection was cancelled. No file was deleted.
You can remove the file just used for this export, including an incomplete copy. Leaving this screen does not delete it.
Delete the exact file chosen for this export? This can remove your only backup. Your current profile and recovery key will not be changed.
The storage app may retain the file in its trash or backups. Copies made elsewhere are not removed.
Asking the storage app to delete the file and checking that it no longer opens…
The storage app accepted deletion and the file no longer opens at its original location. It may still be retained in trash, backups or copies elsewhere.
The file still opens. Deletion was not verified. Check it in the storage app.
Deletion could not be verified. The file may still exist. Check it in the storage app; TaffyGo will not retry automatically.
